name: Skipper Ltd
title: Skipper Ltd - 538562 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Record Q4 and FY26 with order book INR8,502 cr and utilisation above 85%, but FY27 revenue guided only 15% (vs 20-25% historically) as bidding slipped on transformer/HVDC and ROW constraints.

utilisation.quote: Utilization levels has remained strong and are above 85%, indicating strong demand and execution momentum.

capex.quote: For FY '27, our capex guidance will be similar to previous years. It will be about INR250 crores.

triggers.label: Utilisation above 85%
triggers.quote: Utilization levels has remained strong and are above 85%

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 15%, PAT ~30%
triggers.quote: For FY '27, we are giving a guidance of 15% growth on revenue and approximately a 30% growth in bottom line.

triggers.label: Receivables up ~2x to INR1,485 cr
triggers.quote: it's almost double in FY '26 compared to FY '25, INR1,485 crores despite 20% growth

triggers.label: Capacity 450k t by June; 75k t/yr adds
triggers.quote: we are on track to reach 450,000 tons per year capacity by June '26.

triggers.label: FY26 inflows INR5,678 cr; bidding slipped
triggers.quote: FY '26 saw some temporary moderation in ordering due to execution size constraints

guidance.quote: For FY '27, we are giving a guidance of 15% growth on revenue and approximately a 30% growth in bottom line.
approximately a 30% growth in bottom line
It will be about INR250 crores.

guidance.value: 450,000 t by June 2026; 6 lakh t by FY28
guidance.quote: we are on track to reach 450,000 tons per year capacity by June '26.
long term, we will definitely move towards our aspirational margin of 12%.

red_flags.label: Receivables nearly doubled
red_flags.quote: it's almost double in FY '26 compared to FY '25, INR1,485 crores despite 20% growth

red_flags.label: Mgmt blames timing of INR260 cr receipt
red_flags.quote: close to about INR260 crores of funds, which was supposed to receive on the last week of March was received on the 1st and the 2nd of April

evasions.quote: hard for me to put a number, but that's what we have seen historically in the past.
I'm not able to give an exact guidance of how much it will translate to the EBITDA.
